decisions.state_note: o000: visible window roughly x99–162,y91–154; thick upright black band near x117–137 and rising-right segment to its left near x99–118. Both extend beyond view; digit 1 is a hypothesis.

o001: window x99–162,y59–122 shows black rising-right segment joining a broad descending upright near x122–138; upper and lower portions remain cropped. Detector supports upright and rising-right bands. Digit 1 remains a hypothesis.

o002: window x99–162,y27–90 shows a white margin above a black top near y54; a rising-right left arm turns into a descending band near x129–145. Left arm and lower band are cropped. Digits 1 and 7 remain hypotheses.
o003: x99–162,y59–122 again shows a rising-right black arm beside a thick descending band, with a white recess between them. Lower termination remains unseen; inspect below.
o004: window x99–162,y91–154 shows thick upright at x117–137 and rising-right arm on its left; lower shaft is cropped. Need lower termination to assess digit 1 hypothesis.
o005: window x99–162,y123–186 shows a thick near-vertical black shaft around x117–137 continuing through the lower crop; detector agrees on upright band. Lower termination remains unseen.

o006: window x99–162,y155–218 shows the upright shaft curving slightly right into a rounded lower cap, with white below near y217. Together with the previously observed rising-right upper arm and long shaft, this supports digit 1.
